Perfect final night in Saigon
Nov 2023 • Couples
Just around the corner from our hotel and very convenient. We chose an early dinner as it was our final night in Saigon, and the final night of a two week tour from Hanoi. We chose deep fried spring rolls and they were better than most. The soft shell crab with salted egg sauce was an absolute winner, especially with some chilli. A simple beef with noodles gave us a good meal for about $A35 and that included a couple of beers. Nice staff. The waitress was very attentive and deserves a thank you. Highly recommended as other members of our group also ate here and loved it.
